Q1. What exact part of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow under `.github/workflows/` — reply with its filename (RECOMMENDED)
B. One specific script, prompt, or helper file — reply with its repo path (RECOMMENDED)
C. A broader area only — name the phase/feature (for example: clarify, plan, implement, review, orchestrate, validate)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken or incorrect behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability, performance, or cost without changing the visible behavior
C. Add or change behavior
Q3. What concrete detail can you provide so the change is testable? You may answer with multiple letters (for example: `B+C`).
Choices:
A. A failing workflow run, PR, issue number, or error message
B. A short “current behavior → desired behavior” description (RECOMMENDED)
C. A specific acceptance check or success criterion (RECOMMENDED)
